column1: # Connector pane patterns: which conIdx sits where.
# GENERATED by `LabVIEWMCP --panes <sweep file>` - do not edit by hand.

# harvested 2026-08-13 from panesweep_1.txt, panesweep_all.txt, panesweep_b1.txt, panesweep_own.txt, panesweep_resource.txt, panesweep_user.txt, panesweep_vilib2.txt (scripts/lvpane_sweep.xml over this installation)
# slots: conIdx:left,top,right,bottom;... in conIdx order, pane coordinates.
# The array index IS the conIdx. `-` means this pattern was not measured:
# the pattern cannot be set through VI Server, so it can only be observed on
# a VI that already uses it, and no VI in the sweep did.
# columns       = MEASURED slots per column, left to right.
# catalogueShape = the LabVIEW Wiki's string for the same pattern. The two
# disagree on ordering for 4817 and 4820 and on the sum for 4833, so the
# notation counts something other than columns. Kept as an identifier only.
# seenVis  = VIs found on this pattern. variants = distinct ORIENTATIONS among
# them; a pane can be rotated or flipped. The slots below are the majority
# orientation, so variants > 1 means only a live measurement is authoritative.
